# `vortex_cores`

the vortex cores of a band's hatted curl over the burst frames, from the stored threshold, stored as point events.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run vortex_cores --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run vortex_cores --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run vortex_core_threshold --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
nxr-neuro run vortex_cores          --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel", "params.inverse.measure": "$method"} | yes |
| `tiles` | selection ladder, manifold kernel.to (the surface's grid (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first)) | yes |
| `glued` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$glued_surface"} (the glued cortex (`nxr-neuro run glue` first): the computational manifold for spatiotemporal patterns) | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid frames ${band} ${frames_per_cycle} per cycle"} (the band's frame grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule frames --band 8-12Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"} | yes |
| `threshold` | statistic histogram, where {"name": "$threshold_statistic"} | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |
| `onset` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$onset"}, required false | no |
| `within` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$within"}, required false | no |
| `offset` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$offset"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name, or none: found by `method` (the named kernel must also be of that method: --method) |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-12 Hz` | Hz |  | the temporal band as a quantity (the frames and the time grid are resolved from it) |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - |  | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| meyer |
| `spatial_shape` | `--spatial-shape` | `mexhat` | - |  | the spatial level's gain: mexhat \| meyer |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | `parts 32` | mm |  | the spatial band as a quantity: a tile diameter, a wavelength, an eigenvalue, parts per hemisphere or a named scale; its Weyl band is the spatial band |
| `glued_surface` | `--glued-surface` | none | - |  | the glued cortex made by `run glue`, by name; results are restricted back to the original hemispheres |
| `method` | `--method` | `MNE` | - |  | the kernel's inverse method (its params.inverse.measure) |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's transform: auto \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `modes` | `--modes` | `0` | modes |  | when the eigenmodes are computed: the package's size; 0: the standard 3000, or more when the level needs it |
| `order` | `--order` | `0` | degree |  | chebyshev degree; 0: the smallest of 40 to 5120 within `tolerance` of the band's gain |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `0.01` | fraction |  | the largest difference between the band's gain and the chebyshev series that is accepted |
| `frames_per_cycle` | `--frames-per-cycle` | `36` | frames/cycle |  | the frame density: frames to one cycle of the band's centre (the 10 degree step of phase work); the frame is the dyadic tile nearest it |
| `frames_per_tile` | `--frames-per-tile` | none | frames/tile |  | the frame density per tile of the band instead (a power of two); wins over frames_per_cycle when given |
| `origin` | `--origin` | `start` | - | start, clock, event | the frames' origin as a point: start (the recording's first sample) \| clock \| event (a stored selection's first member) |
| `bursts` | `--bursts` | `global_bursts.bursts_kept.{recording}` | - |  | the spans Selection the run uses, by name |
| `threshold_statistic` | `--threshold-statistic` | `vortex_core_threshold.histogram.{recording}` | - |  | the stored distribution (pass one's output), by name |
| `percentile` | `--percentile` | `98.0` | percentile |  | nxr CORE_PCT: the threshold is this percentile of \|curl\| over the burst frames, derived from the stored counts |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans |
| `block_frames` | `--block-frames` | `256` | frames |  | the frames cut at once (memory only: the result does not depend on it) |
| `link_mm` | `--link-mm` | `15.0` | mm |  | nxr CORE_LINK: a core joins the nearest free track of the previous frame (same sense) within this distance of its last centre |
| `stages` | `--stages` | `["burst"]` | - |  | the stages the crossings are counted in: burst (every step), and onset, within, offset when their Selections exist (`global_bursts`: burst_onset, burst_within, burst_offset) |
| `onset` | `--onset` | `global_bursts.burst_onset.{recording}` | - |  | the burst onset spans, by name |
| `within` | `--within` | `global_bursts.burst_within.{recording}` | - |  | the within-burst spans, by name |
| `offset` | `--offset` | `global_bursts.burst_offset.{recording}` | - |  | the burst offset spans, by name |
| `min_frames` | `--min-frames` | `2` | frames |  | the tracks stored hold at least this many frames (2: a track has a step; nxr's lifetime statistics use 3 or more, a filter at read) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.analytic_frames`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, tiling=grid, within=bursts | band=$band, shape=$shape, frames_per_cycle=$frames_per_cycle, frames_per_tile=$frames_per_tile, origin=$origin | z_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z_frames, kernel=kernel, tiles=tiles, glued=glued | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape, form=curl_tan | curl_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.events.cores`](../nodes.md) | x=curl_frames, threshold=threshold, exclude=bad | percentile=$percentile, block_frames=$block_frames, bad_segments=$bad_segments | cores, frame, sense, centre_vertex, centre, area, peak |
| after | [`select.events.tracks`](../nodes.md) | events=cores, frame=frame, sense=sense, centre=centre | link_mm=$link_mm, min_frames=$min_frames | tracks, track_first_frame, track_last_frame, track_n_frames, track_path_length, track_displacement, track_sense, core_track |
| after | [`select.tile_crossings`](../nodes.md) | events=cores, frame=frame, sense=sense, centre=centre, track=core_track, tiles=tiles, onset=onset, within=within, offset=offset | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, stages=$stages | tile_crossings |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE VORTEX CORES, pass two (spec docs/specs/2026-11-14-vortex-cores-port.md, piece 5; docs/specs/2026-11-14-spatial-events.md, decision 1): the connected patches where the hatted curl of the current is above its threshold,
one sense each, in each burst frame (nxr `_core_patches`). The THRESHOLD is read BY NAME from the stored distribution `run vortex_core_threshold` made (`threshold_statistic`), and the percentile (98, nxr's) derived here from
its counts: a core is cut from a threshold it is given.

THE CHAIN is pass one's, to the frames: analytic (Morlet) → frames (inside the named bursts: the sensors' band signal sampled on the tiling) → apply_kernel (form curl_tan, the Mexican hat of the level, on the GLUED surface: linear, so it commutes with the frame sampling) → cores. The kernel runs on the frames only, in blocks of frames (`--block-frames`). The step refuses a threshold made from
another band, level, shape, form or frame tiling.

STORED as POINT EVENTS (point_events.h): a spans Selection `vortex_cores.cores.<recording>` of type `core`, ONE MEMBER PER CORE whose span is the core's frame (members may share a frame: in the order frame, sense +1 first,
lowest vertex), and per core as measurements over that Selection: frame, sense, centre_vertex (a vertex of the glued surface), centre (centre_x, centre_y, centre_z: the |curl|·area-weighted centroid, the surface's unit, m),
area (m²) and peak (the largest sense · curl). Frames are independent: the result does not depend on the chunk size. The cores are DESCRIPTIONS of where the field rotates, not evidence that it does (the lag-free null is, piece 10).

  nxr-neuro run vortex_core_threshold --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
  nxr-neuro run vortex_cores          --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "parts 32" --all
```
